steps.npc: 'Allo mate! Got a job going? Only 500 coins!
I'm a great cook, me! I used to work with a rat-catcher, I used to cook for him. There's a dozen different ways you can cook rat!

options.text: Tell me about your previous jobs

steps.player: Tell me about your previous jobs.

steps.npc: Well, city warder Bravek once threw a chair at me and yelled at me to get him a hangover cure. So I made it and I think it worked, 'cause then he threw another chair at me and that one hit!

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 20 Construction:

steps.npc: Sorry mate, but I'm not allowed to work for anyone without level 20 Construction. It's a safety 'azard!

steps.text: If the player already has a servant:
If the player does not have a second bedroom with a bed:
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
If the player does not have enough money in their inventory:

steps.player: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.

steps.npc: Nice try, mate, but I don't start work without cash up front.

steps.text: If the player has the above conditions met and the player doesn't have a servant:

steps.npc: Cheers, mate! Look forward to working with you!
